reason: I'd connect my Instagram and take the free first collab since the café asked, but I don't pay for creator tools, ever. I've been doing barter collabs fine with DMs and free apps, so ₹499 for Auto-DM and more collabs isn't something I'd spend on.
objection: It's a small beta team in Bengaluru and I don't know who's behind it. If a business ghosts me on payment, who do I complain to? Also the café gets ₹150 when I buy, and I have to make promo videos for businesses as a pass holder, so it feels like I'm the one being sold.
would_change_my_mind: If the free collab actually turned into a paid collab that came through Mitra, with a named company and a clear way to raise a complaint if a business doesn't pay, I might consider the pass after that.
